messages.text:
Thank you for ordering from our website!
 

 Your order was effectively shipped on January 13. Orders of 1 neck gaiter are shipped by regular mail with a stamp. Therefore, it is not possible to track the orders with a number like with packages .
 

 It can take between 5 and 12 business days to arrive, depending on the destination. It should arrive soon!
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-founder 
 Lasclay

messages.subject: Re: Order L-45509
messages.text:
Hello Elizabeth,
 

 Just to confirm that we have received your message and will respond to it as soon as possible. We are currently receiving more requests than usual, but are doing everything we can to process them quickly.
 

 We have not forgotten you! We are taking care of you and you will receive a response shortly. 🙂
 

 See you soon!
 

 Warm regards,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
